targets.authors: Hoekstra R. Morey R. D. Rouder J. N. Wagenmakers E. J.
targets.title: Robust misinterpretation of confidence intervals.
targets.evidence_quote: We replicated Hoekstra et al.'s ( 2014 ) study with extensions that permit telling misinterpretation from incognizance and identifying correct interpretations of CIs.
targets.outcome_quote: Our study provided data opposing Hoekstra et al.'s ( 2014 ) conclusion of a robust misinterpretation of CIs.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The explicit overall verdict opposes the original conclusion. The paper also reanalyses the original data, but its new-sample replication determines the record type.

reasoning: New first-year and master student samples re-test the published confidence-interval interpretation finding; original-data reanalysis is also reported.
